title: Floating help and AI buttons animate without end and cover content on phones and tablets
steps: Open any page at 375 or 768 px (light or dark).
The two round buttons flip continuously; screenshots catch them mid-flip (blank or stretched).
At 390 px on /login the buttons cover the Terms and Privacy Policy links; on /orders they cover the price; on /feed the composer send button.
expected: Decorative motion stops after 5 s or can be paused; floating controls never cover links, prices or inputs.
actual: The flip runs forever (only prefers-reduced-motion stops it). The stacked buttons occupy the lower-right corner over content on phone and tablet layouts.
impact: Constant motion distracts and can affect people with attention or vestibular conditions; covered legal links and prices undermine trust; focused elements under the buttons can be hidden (2.4.11).
fix: Play the flip once (or every 30 s at most for a few seconds) and stop; merge the two launchers into one menu button on mobile; reserve bottom padding on page content (e.g. pb-28 on mobile) and move the launcher above the bottom navigation without overlapping content.
regression_test: Playwright: at 375 px, elementsFromPoint at the Terms link and composer send button returns those elements, not the launcher.
